## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No new third-party imports added (stdlib-only at runtime), or the exception is justified above
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the behavior change
- [ ] For new detection rules: false-positive risk considered and noted above
- [ ] Docs/README updated if user-facing behavior changed
